openBoundaries: Java parse only; same-owner name/arity candidates, inherited/Lombok accessors and virtual/overloaded targets are not attributed
New/returning/intro/fallback paths are a source union, not a required CN72 message sequence
PlayerCreationEvent can replace Player class; PlayerJoinEvent can cancel after ACTIVE; SendPacketEvent can replace/cancel final packet
PluginManager invokes a runtime listener registry; callbacks and external plugins remain open
QuestManager queueEvent/executor, MainQuest rewind/checkProgress and activity handler/watcher dispatch remain data-dependent
SceneScriptManager Lua/group/timer callbacks, scene controllers and resource-conditioned entities remain open
Database load/UID/save service descendants, async tasks and implicit field/class initialization are not closed
AccountLoginAdmission callback/dispatch, UnionCmd inner dispatch and FanOut configuration remain open; A-02b source guards still apply
CN72 client identity/wire evidence and actual new/returning character/scene sequences remain independent and untested

boundarySites.reason: Runtime plugin registry callback; external code and packet replacement are not statically closed
New Thread starts initialization; a source reference does not prove completion before scene entry
afterHostInitCallbacks is a mutable runtime queue
SendPacketEvent can replace the packet after opcode checks; final runtime protocol still requires C-01
Configured legacy fanout is not a CN72 mapping; A-02b review is independent
PlayerCreationEvent can substitute the concrete Player class and reflection factory
Parallel load tasks and save/UID service descendants are not fully expanded
PlayerJoinEvent cancellation after ACTIVE closes session; source union does not prove successful registration
Resource/persisted MainQuest definitions drive rewind and subsequent notifications
Runtime activity handler and watcher implementation depend on schedule/resources
